en.headline: Weekend outlook: cloudy with showers after Saudel fades
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory expects mainly cloudy skies with isolated showers and sunny intervals on Saturday and Sunday, with highs around 31 degrees after tropical cyclone signals were cancelled overnight.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said winds along the Guangdong coast would moderate on Friday after the remnant of Tropical Depression Saudel moved inland, and that weather over the coast should improve through the weekend, though a few showers will linger.

Saturday is forecast to be mainly cloudy with one or two showers and sunny intervals during the day, with west to southwesterly winds of force 3 to 4 and temperatures between 26 and 31 degrees Celsius. Sunday is expected to stay mainly cloudy with a few showers and sunny intervals, under lighter south to southwesterly winds of force 2 to 3, with temperatures of 27 to 31 degrees.

No tropical cyclone warning signal or rainstorm warning was in force in Hong Kong on Friday morning. The Observatory said Tropical Storm Krovanh was lingering near the Ryukyu Islands and was not expected to affect the territory over the weekend. A continental airstream is forecast to bring generally finer weather to southern China early next week, with Monday seeing sunny periods and one or two morning showers and highs of about 32 degrees.

zh.headline: 周末展望：沙德爾消散後多雲有驟雨
zh.dek: 天文台預料周六及周日大致多雲，有一兩陣驟雨，日間間中有陽光，最高氣溫約31度；本港已於凌晨取消所有熱帶氣旋警告信號。
body: 香港天文台表示，熱帶低氣壓沙德爾的殘餘今日影響內陸，廣東沿岸風勢會逐漸緩和。沿岸地區周末天氣將有所改善，但仍有幾陣驟雨。
周六大致多雲，有一兩陣驟雨，日間間中有陽光，吹西至西南風3至4級，氣溫介乎26至31度。周日大致多雲，有幾陣驟雨，日間間中有陽光，吹和緩南至西南風2至3級，氣溫27至31度。
周五上午本港並無熱帶氣旋或暴雨警告生效。天文台指熱帶風暴科羅旺在琉球群島一帶徘徊，預料周末不會影響本港。一股大陸氣流料令華南下周初大致天晴，周一部分時間有陽光，早上有一兩陣驟雨，最高氣溫約32度。
